title: Mixed Event — Smile of a Dreamer — Episode6 From a Tearful Smile

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime picks up the pace in preparation for their final Show Contest performance! At the same time, Emu learns that her brothers are working on a huge overhaul of Phoenix Wonderland. She tries to convince them to reconsider, but will she be successful?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have no idea what happened, what to do or have any ideas to speak of really...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What can we do to get Emu to talk to us...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
So that's what happened...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There must be a reason behind Emu not telling even you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The one thing we do seem to know is that her family is involved.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where is Emu anyway? She didn't come with you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We were together until a second ago, but then she said, If we can't make a decision, let's try some out and make a choice! She's getting props for everything now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I asked her if she needed any help, but she just said she'd be fine and ran off. I think she's trying to avoid us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... We can use this sword for the fight scene and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't let my sadness win! That'll just make everyone worry even more!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want everyone to smile, so that means I need to do the same!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're here! I'm glad you came today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Found you, Emu♪
Everyone, she's over here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! Rin and the plushies too?! What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You seemed a little down the other day and we became worried.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How are you? You can tell us if something's bothering you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm happy and full of energy! See?
Like big old bear in the forest♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is there something you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're not smiling the same way you usually do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, Emu... You don't have to make yourself smile if something is making you feel sad!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whenever something bothers us, it sort of just shows on all of us♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And thanks to that, we're all able to help each other out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So if there is something that's not making you smile, we want to be there to help you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to force yourself to smile!

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <If something's bothering her, I want to be there for her.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that something might be keeping you from telling us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But when you feel like talking, please tell us everything...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is what Nene was trying to say too...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We spent a whole day wondering what to do with no results...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu... I wish you'd just tell us already...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I mean, she has a future star like me to talk to! What is she afraid of?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even that one time, it all came down to the last few seconds and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I need them to help come up with ideas that are different from what Keisuke and Shosuke want to do...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Emu. Keep your dreams to yourself. We're through dealing with you!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: Don't worry. As long as you keep trying, everyone will keep smiling.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: <Ah, excuse me for that. I figured that this would be the best way to find you is all.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What? You were looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: <Yes. I was hoping to show you something. If you don't mind, would you kindly follow the drone?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's heading towards the Ferris wheel...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Finally, you're here! You really kept us waiting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But now our VIP has arrived. My part is done and I leave the rest to you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh... Why are you all here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, to ride the Ferris wheel, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know what exactly he's up to but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We didn't get a chance to do this last time so... Wanna go on it together...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! Then let's all go together!
